rca of the issue: RCA — compile-blocking overlay: AdminUnsubscribeAudit.jsx line 92 had `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`. The CRA build's eslint runtime doesn't have eslint-plugin-react-hooks registered, so it treats the unknown rule name as an error and renders the red 'Compiled with problems' overlay across the entire app — login form was visually present but the overlay intercepted any data-testid-based selectors. Reproduction: visit any page, observe overlay. Mitigation applied: replaced the disable comment with a plain comment (preserves intent without referencing an unloaded rule).
